name: iPhone Connect
author: Badr-Emil
description: Your iPhone on Omarchy over Bluetooth: take and make calls, see its notifications, battery and music. No app on the phone, no cloud.

barWidget.description: Answer, decline, dial and hang up iPhone calls with the PC microphone and speakers; contacts and recent calls; the iPhone's notifications, battery level and now-playing controls.
